BASE.NAME: The Terror Between
BASE.DESCRIPTION: Capture all other non-structure units that are destroyed in this system, including your own.

BASE.NAME: Reanimator
BASE.DESCRIPTION: When your infantry on this planet are destroyed, place them on your faction sheet; those units are captured.

BASE.NAME: Dimensional Tear I
BASE.DESCRIPTION: This system is a gravity rift; your ships do not roll for this gravity rift. Place a dimensional tear token beneath this unit as a reminder. Up to 6 fighters in this system do not count against your ships' capacity.

UPGRADED.NAME: Dimensional Tear II
UPGRADED.DESCRIPTION: This system is a gravity rift; your ships do not roll for this gravity rift. Place a dimensional tear token beneath this unit as a reminder. Up to 12 fighters in this system do not count against your ships' capacity.
